name: Afromedia PLC
source: Afromedia Plc audited financial statements for the period ended 31 December 2022 (NGX doclib filing, approved by the board 31 March 2023). Filing in NGN thousands; stored here in absolute NGN.

rows.label: Operating Expenses
rows.note: Values beyond the declared 5 periods were dropped (6 were present).

rows.label: Operating Profit (EBIT)
rows.derivedFormula: Operating Profit (EBIT) = Gross Profit - Operating Expenses

note: Figures are exactly as the filing prints them. The filing carries one-unit rounding differences in its own table: FY2022 revenue less cost of sales comes to 146,744 against the printed gross profit of 146,745, and FY2021 profit before tax less tax comes to 216,922 against the printed 216,923. The printed values are stored rather than adjusted. There is no FY2020 column in this filing, so FY2020 stays empty. The filing prints EBITDA and not an operating profit line, so Operating Profit (EBIT) is left empty rather than inferred, and no earnings per share is printed. Income tax for FY2022 is nil: the filing shows no tax line and profit after tax equals profit before tax, both printed as 118,114.
derivedCellsNote: Individual blank cells derived from the same file own printed inputs, each tagged derived true with its formula and identity agreement rate.
